title: Smith Machine Squat
summary: A squat on a fixed bar path. It loads the quads hard with less balance and lower-back demand than a free-bar squat.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for quads (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly quads total.
Library rating 0.7 for glutes (helper): each working set adds 0.7 of a set to the weekly glutes total.
Library rating 0.5 for adductors (helper): each working set adds 0.5 of a set to the weekly adductors total.
Library rating 0.2 for lower back: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly lower back total.

setup.text: Set the bar on your upper back and unhook it with a twist of the wrists.
Place your feet slightly in front of the bar, about shoulder width apart.
Sit down with your knees tracking over your toes until your hips are below your knees.
Drive back up and re-hook the bar at the top.

form_cues.cue: Drive up through the whole foot
Feet a little forward shifts work toward the quads and keeps your knees comfortable.

mistakes.text: Placing the feet directly under the bar so the knees jam forward.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds two or three ramp-up sets at rising loads before the first working set, unless that load is very light.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 6-10 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Set safety arms or pins where you can fail a rep safely, or use a spotter, and use collars.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: Less stretch emphasis, One side at a time, Less spinal loading.

notes: Ratings, swap attributes and cues are the library model (modeled). An authored page will replace this one.
